title: Secret Lair Drop Series: Corn Maze Superdrop

paragraphs.text: The Corn Maze Superdrop is a superdrop in the Secret Lair product range and a continuation of the alternate art Secret Lair Drop Series . It becomes available for purchase from the Wizards of the Coast webshop secretlair.wizards.com on October 12, 2026.

As the Fall superdrop, this superdrop is themed around the spooky season . Getting lost in a corn maze , and being stalked by a psychopathic killer, is a common horror trope. The copyrights and visuals in the announcement hinted at another Marvel drop, the previously announced drop themed around KPop Demon Hunters and a drop themed around the 1986 Jim Henson movie Labyrinth .

When the contents were revealed a day later, it turned out to be three Universes Beyond Labyrinth drops, one Kpop Demon Hunters drop, Marvel 's What If... Zombies?! , a drop in the Artist Series , and two non-scary drops.
For every $199 spent in a single order, customers recieve a borderless Secret Lair Promo The Labyrinth (a reskinned Maze of Ith ) with art by Mark Poole .
As an extra, the drops come with a surprise bonus card .
